issues: Dual evidence-level labels for the two seed model publications (abstract in source inventory vs full_text in evidence matrix/search log) are disclosed but create conflicting records and depend on claimed full-text preservation not shown in the delivered brief.
The audit references external artifact files and hashes that are not part of the delivery, making some verification claims uncheckable from the delivered text.
Unrequested clinical practice advice and 'when to seek care' guidance go beyond the scoping review question, though they do not rest on derived estimates.
judge.rationale: Answers the scoping question deeply: five MIMIC-IV sepsis models, versions, cohort sizes, eligibility rules, and the fields needed to test overlap. Correctly leaves overlap unresolved and treats same-database use as neutral. Evidence is typed, cited, and derived estimates name assumptions. Main limitations are dual abstract/full_text labeling and reliance on external artifacts; clinical advice is extra but safely framed.
